title: KnowTeX: dependency graphs of definitions, theorems and proofs from LaTeX and Markdown
description: KnowTeX reads LaTeX projects or Markdown notes and builds the dependency graph of their definitions, theorems and proofs, either from explicit \uses{} annotations (Lean Blueprint compatible) or by inference from cross-references, defined terms and document structure. This release is the version evaluated in the article 'KnowTeX: Extracting Logical Dependencies from Mathematical Texts' (arXiv version: 'KnowTeX: Visualizing Mathematical Dependencies', arXiv:2601.15294); the four evaluation datasets, their configurations, the baseline edge sets and the scripts that produce every table of the article are included.
